resources.string: Interactive {command} wizard. Each field indicates whether input is visible or hidden. Press enter to skip optional fields.
Interactive input requires a terminal on stdin and stderr. Supply command arguments instead; use --help for usage.
Input ended before the command was submitted.
Expected a JSON object. Use --help to inspect the command's fields.
Too many arguments. Use --help to inspect the command's usage.
Missing required JSON body field: {field}. Use --help to inspect the command's fields.
Missing required JSON query field: {field}. Use --help to inspect the command's fields.
Duplicate command input field: {field}. The command owner must use unique field names.
Enter a comma-separated list or a JSON string array. Use [] for an empty list.
Account deleted, but cleanup is incomplete. Do not repeat deletion. Review the server failure and repair the affected cleanup.
Deletion was rejected before the account was removed. Review the refusal before trying again.
Deletion outcome unknown. Verify the account and server records before deciding whether to retry. No retry was sent.
